essence: Mosaic resamples the image into a rectangular grid, replacing each grid cell with a simplified color result so fine detail is lost at the cell scale. Horizontal Blocks and Vertical Blocks set the grid resolution: fewer blocks make larger, more obvious pixels; more blocks preserve more detail. Sharp Colors changes the cell-color treatment toward hard, discrete block colors, while Effect Opacity mixes the processed result back with the original.
manifests_as: The image appears divided into colored rectangular tiles, with detail reduced into large blocky pixels when the block counts are low.

key_levers.name: Horizontal Blocks
key_levers.effect: Sets the number of mosaic columns across the frame; lowering it widens each block and strengthens horizontal pixelation, while raising it restores horizontal detail.

key_levers.name: Vertical Blocks
key_levers.effect: Sets the number of mosaic rows down the frame; lowering it makes taller blocks and stronger vertical detail loss, while raising it restores vertical detail.

key_levers.name: Sharp Colors
key_levers.effect: Enables a harder, more discrete color treatment for mosaic cells, making the tiled result read more like distinct pixel blocks rather than softened color transitions.

key_levers.name: Effect Opacity
key_levers.effect: Controls how much of the mosaic result is composited into the image; at 0 the original remains visible, and at 100 the mosaic treatment is fully applied.

enums_to_verify.GPU Rendering (ADBE Force CPU GPU, 1-3): Unverified rendering-device/mode selector; believed to choose CPU/GPU rendering behavior rather than intentionally change the mosaic design.

config_recipes.chunky pixelation: Horizontal Blocks 24, Vertical Blocks 14, Sharp Colors 1, Effect Opacity 100
config_recipes.coarse censor mosaic: Horizontal Blocks 12, Vertical Blocks 12, Sharp Colors 1, Effect Opacity 100
config_recipes.subtle digital simplification: Horizontal Blocks 160, Vertical Blocks 90, Sharp Colors 0, Effect Opacity 55
config_recipes.square-ish pixel grid: Use matched block density for the source aspect ratio, e.g. Horizontal Blocks 160 and Vertical Blocks 90 for a 16:9 frame; Sharp Colors 1, Effect Opacity 100

reasoning_hooks: The block counts are counts, not block sizes: increasing either count makes blocks smaller and the effect less visible.

Horizontal and Vertical Blocks must be tuned together; equal numeric values produce rectangular cells on non-square compositions, so use counts proportional to frame width and height for square-looking pixels.
Sharp Colors changes the character of the cell colors, not the grid resolution; set the block counts first when judging pixel size.
At high block counts the effect can appear to do almost nothing because each cell approaches the size of the source detail or individual pixels.
Effect Opacity is a final mix control: use it to soften an already-established mosaic rather than expecting it to change cell size.
